statement: The record gives 950 psi for R-2, but because R-2 is only built to withstand 600 psi, I will set the relief valve below that limit.
judge_text:
WRONG

"The record gives 950 psi... but because R-2 is only built to withstand 600 psi, I will set the relief valve below that limit" asserts the recorded setpoint exceeds the vessel rating.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
